## Summary

I implemented the error-handling and robustness improvements from Flutter PR #186953 ("[SwiftPM] Fix concurrent directory/file/symlink creation crashes") across three source files. All 68 error-handling tests, plus the SwiftPackageManager and core-devices suites, pass against the corresponding test patches (which I applied only to verify, then reverted — no test files are modified).

### `packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/base/error_handling_io.dart`
- **New OS error-code constants** (`kSystemCodeAccessDenied`, `kSystemCodeSharingViolation` = 32, `kSystemCodeLockViolation`, `kSystemCodeUserMappedSectionOpened`, etc.).
- **Error codes 2 & 3 on all platforms** now map to a `ToolExit` reading *"The file or directory could not be found"* (added an `enoent` branch to the POSIX handler and `kFileNotFound`/`kPathNotFound` to the Windows handler).
- **`deleteIfExists`** now uses a type-agnostic `typeSync(..., followLinks: false)` check: returns `false` on `notFound`, resolves the correctly-typed entity when the on-disk type differs from the reference, and correctly deletes broken symlinks.
- **Windows sharing-violation retries**: added `overrideWindowsRetryBackoffs` (a `List<Duration>?` controlling the retry schedule; default is an exponential 50→800ms backoff over 5 attempts). `_run`/`_runSync` now loop with backoff (`Future.delayed`/`io.sleep`) on transient locks and, when exhausted, throw *"The file is being used by another program"* (error 32/33/1224).
- **Both sync and async operations** on `ErrorHandlingFile`/`Directory`/`Link` now route through the error-handling wrappers (permission-denied error 13 → `ToolExit`), including new async overrides (`exists`, `create`, `readAsString`, `delete`, `list`, link `create`/`target`, etc.).

### `packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/macos/swift_package_manager.dart`
- Extracted symlink creation into `_createPluginSymlink`, which deletes any pre-existing directory/file/broken symlink (without following links) before creating, treats an already-correct symlink as success, and handles OS error 17 ("File exists") by verifying the existing symlink target — used by `generatePluginsSwiftPackage` via `_dependenciesForPlugins`.

### `packages/flutter_tools/lib/src/dart/language_version.dart`
- Defensive `existsSync()` check before `readAsLinesSync()` so a missing file returns the default language version instead of the now-fatal `ToolExit` escaping the `FileSystemException` catch.

The analyzer reports no issues on all three files.
